item.title: The quiet, wintery thrill of a freezing Illinois canyon hike
item.description: <p>There is nothing quite like the snap-cold solitude of a winter hike in the canyons of Matthiessen State Park. The footprints of the last snowfall are a hiker’s only companion — and trail guide. At times, even those disappear, and the lonely hiker is left to imagine the well-trod trail that lies under a pristine layer of snow, and where it might lead.</p><p>Matthiessen, with its mature hardwood forest surrounding sandstone dells, sits 90 miles west of Chicago between Ottawa and LaSalle-Peru.
